name: MultiCombobox
summary: Combobox that accepts multiple selected values.

props.name: items
props.description: Flat options or groups with headings.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected options, as chips inside the field.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: For a remote search: you filter, the component only shows.

props.name: loading
props.description: Announces "Loading…" while your search is in flight.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns off the field, the buttons and the chip removals at once.

props.name: empty
props.description: What the list shows when nothing matches. `loading` still wins over it, so the list never flashes 'No results' while a query is in flight.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is selected. With chips in the field it only shows on an empty selection.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the INPUT, not of the container — it is what a <label htmlFor> has to point at. Without it one is generated.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the field wrapper, not onto the input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Goes to the input, which is the focusable node. It is spelled out because this component unpacks a fixed list of props and silently drops anything else — that is what kept Field from reaching the input (AUD-0001).

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Same route and same reason as aria-describedby: the input carries it, the wrapper would not announce it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label — a filter in a grid without labels (C-01). With `label`, prefer `label`.
